title.narrative: Development of Amani Garden as an educational centre in the community of Biddi

description.narrative:
The purpose of the project is to promote sustainable food and nutrition security of Bidii community by use of ecological farming techniques. Although Kitale has generally been a highly agricultural potential region continous use of ianppropriate farming techniques mainly us eof chemicals, environmental degradation, land subdivision as a result of population explosion has led to reduced food production leaving most poor hosueholds especially slum dwellers and small farm holders food insecure.
OTEPIC has been working with these poor communites for over two years supporting ecological farming and other livelihood support activities for the community to ensure improved access to food and other basic necessities. Over the period OTEPIC has been able together with the community to identify the essential needs for Bidii community in order to attain sustainable food security and has designed a project that wiill focus on capacity building of the community in appropritate and sustainable food production methods.
